_metadata.note: Subsidies, project cost ceilings, promoter contribution requirements, and category eligibility are aligned strictly with official operational manuals.

schemes.sponsoring_agency: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of MSME, Govt of India
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Rural and urban micro-entrepreneurs, unemployed youth, SHGs, special categories

eligibility_criteria.min_education: 8th Pass for manufacturing projects above ₹10 Lakhs and service projects above ₹5 Lakhs
eligibility_criteria.family_restriction: Only one person from one family is eligible

schemes.official_guidelines_reference: Operational Guidelines for Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) Revised 2022-2026, Ministry of MSME.

schemes.implementing_agency_state: Directorate of Industries, Maharashtra & District Industries Centres (DIC)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Domiciled youth of Maharashtra establishing new micro-enterprises in manufacturing or service sectors

eligibility_criteria.domicile: Must be permanent resident / domicile of Maharashtra State
eligibility_criteria.min_education: 7th standard pass for project cost up to ₹10 Lakhs; 10th standard pass for above ₹10 Lakhs

schemes.official_guidelines_reference: Government Resolution (GR) Industries Department, Government of Maharashtra No. CMEGP-2019/C.R. 29/Ind-7.

schemes.scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme
schemes.sponsoring_agency: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI), Government of India
schemes.implementing_agency_state: Maharashtra State Agricultural Marketing Board (MSAMB) & Dept of Agriculture, Maharashtra
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Individual micro food processors, FPOs, SHGs, and Producer Cooperatives under ODOP (One District One Product)

eligibility_criteria.ownership: Sole proprietorship, partnership, or FPO engaged in food processing
eligibility_criteria.odop_preference: Projects under One District One Product (ODOP) receive priority processing

schemes.official_guidelines_reference: Operational Guidelines for PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme, MoFPI.

schemes.sponsoring_agency: Ministry of MSME & Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Govt of India
schemes.implementing_agency_state: District Industries Centre & Common Service Centres (CSC)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 designated trades (including Tailors / Darzi, Blacksmiths, Potters)
schemes.collateral_requirement: Collateral-free enterprise credit guarantee provided by Govt of India

eligibility_criteria.occupation: Must be engaged in one of the 18 recognized traditional artisanal trades

schemes.official_guidelines_reference: PM Vishwakarma Operational Guidelines, Ministry of MSME, Govt of India (September 2023).

schemes.sponsoring_agency: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
schemes.implementing_agency_state: Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Small Finance Banks, and NBFCs
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises seeking micro-credit

margin_money_subsidy_percent.credit_guarantee: 100% Credit Guarantee under CGFMU (Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units)

schemes.collateral_requirement: Strictly collateral-free under RBI and DFS directives

eligibility_criteria.cibil_track: Satisfactory credit history, non-defaulter with any commercial or cooperative bank
eligibility_criteria.target_sector: Micro manufacturing, trading, retail or service establishment

schemes.official_guidelines_reference: Operational Guidelines for Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY), Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency Ltd (MUDRA).
